transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I suppose... well, things have just gotten a bit difficult lately. I’ve gotten to where I... I plan my whole summer around avoiding wasps. 

I even had to give up my garden jobs at the church because of it. And... if I hear buzzing, I just make my husband unload things by the back porch. I just... I try to stay away from them.
Are you afraid of wasps?

Yes. I suppose... well, I know it's just a little insect. Most folks would just swat it away, I guess. But... to me, it just feels like... like something terrible is about to happen if one gets anywhere near me.
Are you afraid of anything else besides wasps?
No... I don't think so. Just... just the wasps.
Have you ever had to change your daily routine because of your fear of wasps?

Well... yes. Like I said, I had to stop helping with the church garden. I used to host garden days, too... it was nice, seeing folks. But I can't do that anymore. And at home... well, my husband just does all the porch and yard work now. I just... I stay inside mostly.
Do you avoid other outdoor activities besides gardening because of your fear of wasps?

Well... yes, I suppose. I just... I plan my whole summer around avoiding them, really. That's why I'm here. It's not just the church garden. Even at home... if I hear buzzing, I make my husband unload things by the back porch. I just... I can't be out there.
How distressing is it for you when you see a wasp or think about wasps?

It's... it's very distressing. I mean... I know it's just a little insect. Most folks would just swat it away and go about their business. But... I don't know, to me, it just feels like something terrible is about to happen if one gets anywhere near me. It's... it's a lot to deal with.
Do you ever feel like you're going to panic when you see a wasp or think one might be near?
Yes... I do. The second I hear that buzzing, or see one hovering near the flowers... my heart just jumps. My hands start shaking. I just... I feel like I have to get inside right away.
How long have you been afraid of wasps?
It's been... well, a little over two years. Since we remodeled the house. They... they found a nest during the work. That was about two years and five months ago, I think.
Is your fear of wasps because you're afraid of being stung by them?
I'm... not really sure. I mean, nobody wants to get stung, but... I don't know if that's exactly it. I just... I just really can't be around them.
Is your fear of wasps because you think being stung would be very painful or have serious health consequences?
I don't... I don't really think it's that. I mean, I don't sit there worrying about having a medical emergency or... or how bad it'll hurt. I just... I just want to get away from them.
Do you think your fear of wasps is excessive or unreasonable?

I guess... maybe. I mean, I know it's just a little insect. Most folks would just swat it away, I suppose. But... I don't know, to me, it just feels like something terrible is about to happen if one gets anywhere near me. So... yes.
Is your fear of wasps only when you're outdoors or can it happen anywhere, even when you're inside?
I... I'm not really sure. I haven't really thought about it like that. I guess... if I see one, it doesn't really matter if I'm inside or outside. I just don't want to be near it.
Have you ever had an intense fear reaction to anything else like wasps, such as snakes, spiders, or other animals?
No, I... I don't think so. Just the wasps.
Is your fear of being in a situation where you might see a wasp, like a garden or a picnic, or is it the wasp itself that scares you?
I... I don't really know. I suppose it's just the wasp itself. I don't really think about the places... just, if I see one, that's what bothers me.
Is it the thought of the wasp's presence itself that scares you, or is it what the wasp might do if it's near you?

I suppose... I know it's just a little insect. Most folks would just swat it away without thinking. But... I don't know. To me, it just feels like... like something terrible is about to happen if one gets anywhere near me.
Is it the way the wasp looks that scares you or what it might do to you?
I... I couldn't really say. I don't think I've ever stopped to figure that out. I just... I just know I don't want them anywhere near me.
Is it the appearance of the wasp or something else about it that scares you?
I... I don't really know how to answer that. I just... I don't like looking at them. I don't really think about what part of it is scary, it just is.
Is there something specific about the wasp that scares you?
No... not really. I... I don't know what else to tell you about it. It's just the whole thing.
Is there something specific about the wasp's behavior that scares you?
I... I really couldn't say. I don't stick around long enough to watch what they're doing. It's just... like I said, it's just the bugs themselves. I don't know how else to explain it.
